answer: Cloud Computing is defined as encompassing both the applications delivered as services over the Internet and the hardware and systems software located in the datacenters that provide these services. The services themselves are also referred to as Software as a Service (SaaS), while the datacenter hardware and software are collectively termed a Cloud. When a Cloud is made available to the general public on a pay-as-you-go basis, it is called a Public Cloud, and the service sold is Utility Computing. The term Private Cloud refers to internal datacenters of a business or organization not accessible to the general public. Therefore, Cloud Computing is the sum of SaaS and Utility Computing, but it does not typically include Private Clouds.

Το Utility Computing είναι η υπηρεσία που πωλείται όταν ένα Cloud διατίθεται στο ευρύ κοινό με τρόπο pay-as-you-go. Αυτή η διάθεση ενός Cloud στο κοινό ονομάζεται Public Cloud. Επομένως, το Utility Computing αποτελεί την υπηρεσία που προσφέρεται μέσω ενός Public Cloud. Παραδείγματα δημόσιου Utility Computing περιλαμβάνουν τα Amazon Web Services, Google AppEngine και Microsoft Azure.
